shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,105p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'navigation|icons|uikit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'ls -a && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider TextInput Modal TextArea Select Progress Avatar Label && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md && rg -n '"'^#|ThemeProvider|--g-color-base-(utility|info|success)'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md | head -70"

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider TextInput Modal TextArea Select Progress Avatar Label && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'peerDependencies' -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs | head -25 && rg -n -- '--g-color-(base|text)-(utility|info|success)|--g-spacing|--g-border-radius' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'export.*(House|Squares4|Folder|Note|Magnifier|Plus|ArrowUpRight|ArrowRight|Moon|Sun|Bell|Check|Clock|CircleQuestion|Ellipsis|ArrowDown|Calendar|Xmark|Link|Trash|LayoutHeader|BookOpen|CircleCheck|Sparkles|Person)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && rg -n 'CSS|--gn|--g-color-base|--g-color-text' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | tail -35 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-color-(base-utility|text-utility|base-info|base-success|text-positive|text-dark-primary|text-light-primary|base-float|line-generic)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -30 && sed -n '300,317p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && rg -n 'interface LogoProps|type LogoProps' -A45 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/Select.d.ts | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -75 && rg -n 'Note|Magnifier|Moon|Squares4' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/AvatarText.d.ts && rg -n 'onUpdate|checked' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,110p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && rg -n -C 3 'spacing|breakpoint' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -60 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts && rg -n 'options\\??:|value\\??:|onUpdate\\??:|size\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -22 && rg -n 'base-(positive|success)|text-info|text-warning|base-warning' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -20 && rg -n 'caption|rightAdornment' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @bem-react/classname'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '104,114p' src/App.tsx | fold -w 180 && git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
import fs from 'node:fs';const p='src/App.tsx';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace('</Button>)}</>}<Flex className=\"dialog-actions\"','</Button>)}</Flex></>}<Flex className=\"dialog-actions\"');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);
JS
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && rg -n 'type =|type:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.js | head -15 && rg -n 'Avatar|background-color|--g-avatar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.css | head -25 && rg -n 'size|width' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/variables.css | head -30 && cat package.json && rg -n -- '--g-border-radius-xl|--g-text-display-3-font-size|--g-color-sfx-shadow|--g-color-base-utility-heavy:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -12"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules | rg '/(prettier|react-test-renderer|jsdom|happy-dom|tsx|esbuild)/package.json"'$'"' | head -20 && cat .gitignore && rg -n -- '--gn-aside-header-size|--gn-aside-header-expanded-width|--gn-aside-header.*width|--gn-aside-header-item-height' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -20 && rg -n -- '--g-color-base-misc-light|--g-color-base-utility-light' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/Progress.css | head -15 && rg -n 'misc' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/Progress.css | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,95p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/Progress.css && rg -n -- '--g-button-(border-color|text-color|background-color)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -12 && rg -n -- '--g-label-background-color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.css | head -5"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/styles.css index.html'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '70030,70175p' node_modules/.cache/orbita-smoke.cjs | head -145 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/CompositeBar.js | head -110 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -65"
